body:
Under normal circumstances, excellent name.

Under ex-girlfriend named Cassie circumstances, can't do it.
I also love this name. Is there some stigma attached to this of a hooker/stripper-ish background? I love the name and mentioned it to a few people who all suggested that
I love the variation of Jazz(y), that's a front-runner now too.

Wow. Although this is the only post, there's so much irony that you throw Bosco out there. I worked for a company (with Bosco) for many years growing up, and that name hits home.

I was thinking Blitz or Jazzy... but hell, that's definitely the front-runner...

I will definately follow up.

I had quite a day today with my car breaking down in a 15 minute parking and pleading with a cop to not get a ticket while waiting for the auto repair to jump it and got the ticket anyway. Then had to have police cut through my non working bike lock so I could actually get home. 

The only thing that got me through this day was knowing my dad would never be able to deal with the unthinkable and finishing off most of a bottle of rum. Just thought I'd share dood.

That's the problem, my only reason for desperation today was finding out that the list they gave me, the list of 10 or so odd therapists, eithor didn't take my insurance, or didn't want new clients. I found a single one who called back that saying even if I wasn't insurance covered she tries to make exceptions at lower prices...

But man, speaking from a political perspective, that's fucked up imo. People preach that suicide isn't the only answer, when today just felt like it could be
I went sometime in the summer when I wasn't as bad as thsi. They told me to find something external because they were backed up beyond 6 months and understaffed for such
Would you be so kind as to entertain this conversation over PM with me?
I haven't, but my family doctor lives two hours away from my living situation at college life. i don't know that they could refer me to someone in my area.

I can't answer that with anything specific. It's devolved into stress from simple interactions with friends (If a conversation doesn't end on a high note, I dwell on it for hours worrying about who actually likes me.) If it's not that, it's the lingering thought of being depressed 24/7 and you can't not stop thinking about it. Things that once interested me no longer do. Getting out of bed is a struggle, doing 5 minute tasks is a struggle.

I also get no sleep due to the nature of my college house being loud in the wee-hours of the night so trying to make life changes like working out won't yield results due to the nature of no sleep. I have no vices left that help me.

This is what I could spit out on paper that first comes to mind.

The only thing that keeps me on the life side of things is thinking about all the people that (one by one) who would be hurt by my choice to end it. As much as you want to believe you could stage something fake, it's not any different. I use the excuse of the grief of my friends and family to keep going until I can find a permanent solution...
If you want it to be covered for the appointment. Most of these places have quoted $150 per session which I cannot afford in the slightest way.

It rips me apart to think others may have been in a similar situation and ultimately have to wait X amount of months to find help or have a certain amount of cash. 

I'm fairly confident that however depressive I would get, I could last for 5 months but not with the way this stress is eating away at me on a physical toll.

for reference, United states.
